metadata.name: foc_mcsdk_bridge_vectors_2026-06-22
metadata.decision: MCSDK host-side FOC and sensorless comparison bridge / host-side no-power semantic translation only / no firmware implementation / no generated-code edit / no MCSDK observer equivalence / no MCSDK integration / no PWM output / no motor readiness
metadata.scope: host-side no-power comparison bridge fixture only
metadata.assumption_note: These vectors freeze only comparison-ready translation rules for q/d field order, angle-domain mapping, duty-to-count representation, sensorless observer-output snapshots, lock-aware speed/current command snapshots, signed reverse speed/current command snapshots, signed reverse target-omega rate-limit command-ramp snapshots, reverse target-omega startup hold snapshots, reverse target-omega lock-threshold handoff snapshots, positive-to-reverse target-omega crossing snapshots, positive-to-reverse target-omega loss/relock observer snapshots, and positive-to-reverse target-omega loss/relock speed/current snapshots. They are not proof that MCSDK generated code, an MCSDK observer, firmware speed loop, or firmware current-limiting strategy numerically matches the host-side Python model.
